name: fld_irreducible_X_sq_add_one_zmod_iff
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1 : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ↔ p % 4 = 3
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 1 : Polynomial (ZMod p)) ↔ p % 4 = 3
informal: X^2 + 1 is irreducible over F_p iff p ≡ 3 (mod 4) — a monic quadratic is irreducible iff it has no root (Polynomial.Monic.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three), and a root is a square root of -1, which exists iff p % 4 ≠ 3 (ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff).
